title: Exactly K Kinds
statement:
A long shelf holds `n` books in a row, and each book has a genre number. A stretch is any block of one or more consecutive books. Count the stretches that contain exactly `k` different genres. Two stretches covering different positions are different, even if they list the same genres.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `n` integers, the genre of each book in order.

## Output
Print the number of stretches that contain exactly `k` different genres. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 100000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
